items.title: Daily X Report — 2026-11-14
items.detail:
Today's main threads: in AI, agents moved into meetings — Claude Meetings launched and Grok Bot followed — Google shipped the first Gemini 4 model, Hydrogen, while Anthropic published its safety-evaluation methodology and pushed ahead with its IPO. In markets, the Nvidia Jensen Huang saga kept escalating: the board asked shareholders to vote to reinstate him and a public letter passed 65,000 signatures, while global equity funds still pulled in a record $98B weekly inflow.

1. Claude Meetings launches: AI agents join meetings - Claude can now join team video calls, producing docs and whiteboards live; rolling out in beta to Team and Enterprise plans. https://x.com/claudeai/status/2120973994191094179

2. Gemini 4 Hydrogen, the first Gemini 4 model - Google's first Gemini 4 model targets fast coding, multimodal synthesis and daily workflows, claimed 2.5x faster task completion than 3.8 Flash and ahead of Argon on Artificial Analysis. https://x.com/GoogleDeepMind/status/2120940338869055788

3. Anthropic publishes safety evaluation methodology - A blog with 10 recommendations on designing, running and reporting evaluations, explaining how they decide whether a model can deploy — a safety credential alongside its IPO. https://x.com/AnthropicAI/status/2121317227618340990

4. ChatGPT merchant features enter beta - Merchants can claim and manage their business info, see interaction insights, and eligible ones can build a Business Agent to answer customers. https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2120216592395174382

5. World action model Praxis-1 open-sourced - Runway opened Praxis-1 to everyone, turning video pretraining into real robot control, weights under Apache 2.0, runnable and fine-tunable on own hardware. https://x.com/runwayml/status/2120533081182577116

6. Praxis-1 now runs on the SO-101 robot - Running on thousands of LeRobot community datasets on a single RTX 5090, with checkpoints and build instructions — a concrete world-model deployment. https://x.com/runwayml/status/2121252482454335530

7. Anthropic announces IPO, files registration statement with the SEC - The AI leader filed a registration statement including a prospectus, a landmark capital-markets event. https://x.com/AnthropicAI/status/2120841731302154708

8. Letter to reinstate Jensen Huang passes 65,000 signatures - Nvidia's board asked shareholders to vote for the reinstatement proposal, called one of the biggest US corporate-governance events ever; Musk also publicly questioned Nvidia's board. https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2121514973809799294

9. Nvidia proxy statement gives no reason for Huang's ouster - The filing asks shareholders to back reinstatement but does not explain why Huang was fired and removed from the board. https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2121582019138171310

10. Global equity funds take in $98B in a week, second-largest ever - Year-to-date inflows hit $1.03 trillion as money keeps chasing risk despite AI-stock volatility. https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2121564824760902115

11. China's Jan–Oct trade surplus hits record $1.04 trillion - Up $84B (+8.8%) year on year; October exports +35% to $412B, imports +42% to $307B. https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2121406221081043368

12. FAA issues nationwide ground-stop advisory citing 'special circumstances' - A breaking aviation and travel-market event, drawing 634,000 views the same day. https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2121353187630494160

# 今日推特精选报告（2026-11-14）

今天 X 上的主线有三条。AI 方面，智能体正式走进会议室——Claude Meetings 上线，Grok Bot 也跟进；谷歌发布 Gemini 4 首个模型 Hydrogen，Anthropic 则一边公布安全评估方法论、一边推进 IPO。金融方面，英伟达黄仁勋去留风波继续发酵，董事会已要求股东投票恢复其职务，公开信签名超过 6.5 万；而与此同时，全球股票基金单周净流入 980 亿美元，资金仍在追逐风险。

## 一、AI 实用 / Agent

### 1. Claude Meetings 上线：AI 智能体进会议
Claude 可被加入团队视频会议，边开会边生成文档、白板等成果，Team 与 Enterprise 计划开始 Beta 推送——智能体直接进入会议工作流的具体产品，当天互动最高的产品帖之一（760 万观看）。
https://x.com/claudeai/status/2120973994191094179

### 2. Gemini 4 首个模型 Hydrogen 发布
谷歌发布 Gemini 4 家族首个模型 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，定位快速编码、多模态综合与日常工作流，称任务完成速度比 3.8 Flash 快 2.5 倍，并在 Artificial Analysis 智能指数上超过 Argon。
https://x.com/GoogleDeepMind/status/2120940338869055788

### 3. Anthropic 发布安全评估方法论
Anthropic 发布安全评估方法论博客，给出设计、运行与报告评估的 10 条建议，说明评估如何判断模型能否部署、需要哪些保障。结合其 IPO 进程，这份方法论也是给市场的一份安全背书。
https://x.com/AnthropicAI/status/2121317227618340990

### 4. ChatGPT 商家功能进入 Beta
ChatGPT 内商家功能进入 Beta，商家可认领并管理自己的信息、查看用户互动洞察，符合条件的商家还能搭建 Business Agent 回答顾客问题——AI 应用从问答走向商家触达。
https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2120216592395174382

## 二、AI 视频 / 世界模型

### 5. 世界动作模型 Praxis-1 开源开放
Runway 的世界动作模型 Praxis-1 向所有人开放，把视频预训练转化为真实机器人的控制能力，权重以 Apache 2.0 开源，可在自有硬件上运行与微调。
https://x.com/runwayml/status/2120533081182577116

### 6. Praxis-1 已可在 SO-101 机器人上运行
Praxis-1 已可在 SO-101 机器人上运行，基于 LeRobot 社区分享的数千个数据集，单块 RTX 5090 即可运行，并提供检查点与搭建说明，是世界模型落地的具体实例。
https://x.com/runwayml/status/2121252482454335530

## 三、金融与市场

### 7. Anthropic 宣布 IPO，已向 SEC 提交注册声明
Anthropic 宣布首次公开募股，已向美国证券交易委员会提交注册声明（含招股说明书），是 AI 头部公司走向资本市场的重要事件。
https://x.com/AnthropicAI/status/2120841731302154708

### 8. 要求恢复黄仁勋职务的公开信签名超 6.5 万
要求恢复黄仁勋英伟达 CEO 职务的公开信签名已超 6.5 万，英伟达董事会已要求股东投票支持该提案，该事件被称为美国历史上最大的公司治理事件之一；马斯克也公开质疑英伟达董事会的治理。
https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2121514973809799294

### 9. 英伟达代理声明未解释黄仁勋被解雇原因
英伟达本周的代理声明要求股东投票支持恢复黄仁勋职务的提案，但文件未解释黄仁勋为何被解雇并逐出董事会——风波仍在发酵，股东投票成为下一步焦点。
https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2121582019138171310

### 10. 全球股票基金本周净流入 980 亿美元，史上第二大
全球股票基金本周净流入 980 亿美元，为有记录以来第二大单周流入；今年迄今累计流入 1.03 万亿美元。AI 股剧烈波动之际，资金仍在涌入股市。
https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2121564824760902115

### 11. 中国前 10 个月贸易顺差创纪录达 1.04 万亿美元
2026 年前 10 个月中国贸易顺差同比增加 840 亿美元（+8.8%），达创纪录的 1.04 万亿美元；其中 10 月出口同比 +35% 至 4,120 亿美元，进口同比 +42% 至 3,070 亿美元。
https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2121406221081043368

### 12. 美国 FAA 以“特殊情况”为由发布全国停飞建议
突发：美国 FAA 以“特殊情况”为由发布全国停飞建议，涉及航空与出行市场，当天互动量达 63.4 万观看，是值得关注的突发市场事件。
https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2121353187630494160
